description: Tracked PyQED benchmark entry points. Candidate means that a script exists but no release-level result is asserted by this catalog.

status_definitions.candidate: Runnable entry point awaiting a reviewed standardized result manifest.
status_definitions.reviewed: A specific result has a complete manifest and reviewed artifacts.
